item.title: SisDeli
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Milk Candy
  • 発売日: 2011-11-18
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: しすデリ
  • 英語名: SisDeli

别名

  • Shisuderi

あらすじ

Kenichi Tajima was an average “freeter” or freelance part-timer.

He lived on his own at the moment.

He had no girlfriend, so after work he spent all his time online.

Today he’d won a small lottery jackpot, good for casual shopping.

How should he spend the money? He scrolled through his bookmarks.

Ah, “SisDeli”, an escort service that catered to guys like Kenichi. Guys with an elder sister complex.
